title: PU-12M lesson 3: the squad leader
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: headset_on_squad_leader, deploy_orient) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources; the check of communications (voenizdat_osa_1991 p. 251, pvo_bu_ix_1984) against the radio data (rrs_1986: frequencies by conditional number, call signs, the main station)
notes: The battery commander's orders are given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace. The lesson's scenario starts with the headset off.

steps.title: The squad leader's seat
lines: You are the squad leader (No. 1): front right.

You orient the post: you measure which way it faces with the PAB-2 aiming circle, hold that direction with the GAK gyro, and plot the post's position with the KP-4. Every azimuth the post gives the launchers is only as good as your orientation. You also keep the post's watch on the covered regiment's net, and check that the post's communications are ready.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your headset (шлемофон)
lines: First your шлемофон: put it on and plug its cord into your box, the PVS-2.
Without it you hear only voices in the cabin: no intercom, no radio.
steps.hint: J: put it on (or point the cross at it, left click).

steps.title: The PVS-2 box
lines: The PVS-2: its selector puts your headset on the intercom (ВС) or on one of the post's sets, РСТ-1 to РСТ-4, and you hear the intercom on any of them. Its button calls the commander's RTK-1.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   K: turn your box.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The R-123M (FuG-1)
lines: Above you: the R-123M FuG-1, the air-picture net (the radar company, Ромашка). You switch it on; the radio operator listens to it and reads the reports to the plotter.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The GAK's control panel
lines: At your right: the GAK, the gyro direction indicator. Once given a measured direction it holds it as the post stands.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The PAB-2 aiming circle
lines: Its case: the PAB-2, set up on its tripod outside to measure a direction from a landmark.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The KP-4 plotter
lines: Ahead of you: the KP-4 coordinate and course plotter.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The IT-1M status board
lines: And the IT-1M board: a column of lamps for each launcher, ready, on a target, launched, its missiles.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The commander: «Пункт управления развернуть!»
lines: The battery commander orders the post deployed (you hear it on the intercom). Your part: your radio, the orientation, and your box on the covered regiment's net.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your R-123M on: ПИТАНИЕ
lines: Switch your R-123M (FuG-1) on: the air-picture net.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The GAK on
lines: Switch the GAK on: its gyro runs up.
steps.why: A gyro needs minutes to run up and settle: start it first.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Set up the PAB-2
lines: Set up the PAB-2 aiming circle outside, 35 m ahead of the post: clicking its case takes you out through your hatch, down the side and out to where it stands; there you level it and measure the post's direction (the crew waits for no one: it takes you a minute).
steps.why: The aiming circle is the post's compass: its measured direction is what the GAK will hold.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Enter the measured direction into the GAK
lines: When the direction is measured, go back in (F by the front wheel climbs up, F at your hatch climbs in), and when the GAK has run up press its button to enter it.
steps.why: From now on the GAK knows which way the post faces.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The KP-4 on
lines: Switch the KP-4 on.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The DTP's parallax set
lines: Set the DTP's parallax: the post's offset from the reference point, for the telecode (it is low by your knee: L takes you there).
steps.hint: L: step to it.   Left click.

steps.title: Your box on the covered regiment's net: РСТ-2
lines: Your PVS-2 to РСТ-2: your headset on the FuG-2, the covered motor-rifle regiment's net (Клён). You still hear the intercom.
steps.why: The commander warns the covered regiment of the air on this net; you listen to it while his ears are on the battery net and the regiment's.
steps.hint: K: turn your box (two clicks).

steps.title: Bring the PAB-2 back in
lines: The post is oriented and your work inside is done: go out again for the aiming circle and bring it in (its case takes you there).
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Report it: «Ориентирование закончено!»
lines: Tell the commander: O, then «Ориентирование закончено!» (Post oriented!).
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The radio data (радиоданные)
lines: You check the communications against the radio data, on the radio operator's table behind you (L): for each net its name, its frequencies by number (1 the working, 2 the spare), the post's call sign on it and its main station's.

The post is Рябина to the regiment (Тополь), the radar company (Ромашка) and the covered regiment (Клён); on its own battery net it is 10, the main station. Each set must be on its net's working frequency, number 1, unless the main station has moved the net.
steps.why: The radio data are the battery's orders for its communications (rrs_1986): a set on the wrong number, or a wrong call sign, and the net is lost however warm the set.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Check the communications
lines: Before the commander reports the post ready, you check its communications: every set warm and able to transmit (three minutes after duty reception), the RTK-1 on, the mast up, and every man's headset on and plugged in.
steps.hint: Enter: next.

steps.title: Report it: «Связь готова!»
steps.wait_text: every set able to transmit, the RTK-1 on, the mast up, every headset on
lines: When all of it holds: O, then «Связь готова!» (Communications ready!).
steps.why: The commander judges the post's readiness from the crew's reports and a check of the means of control and communication (voenizdat_osa_1991).
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The crew deploys
lines: Your part is done. The others finish theirs.

steps.title: The squad leader's part: done
lines: That is your part: your headset on, your radio on, the post oriented with the PAB-2 and the GAK, the KP-4 and the DTP set, your box on the covered regiment's net, and the communications checked against the radio data and reported.
Esc, then M: the missions menu, and the next seat's lesson.
